earlyEstimate.title: Igereranyo ry'umusaruro rya mbere: isuzuma ryukuri
earlyEstimate.tagline: Uburyo igereranyo rya mbere rihuye n'umusaruro nyawo mbere y'uko ubushakashatsi busohoka, rigereranywa n'uburyo bubiri busanzwe.
earlyEstimate.empty: Nta makuru y'isuzuma kuri iki gihingwa n'iki gihembwe.
earlyEstimate.leadCaption: Ikosa ryo hagati (MAPE) muri buri mwaka wagenzuwe. Umubare muto niwo mwiza. Moderi nziza kuri iki gihe igaragazwa n'inyandiko igufi.
earlyEstimate.honestyTitle: Impamvu uru rupapuro rwerekana moderi zose, atari iyiza gusa
earlyEstimate.honestyBody1: Moderi izahora inesha igereranyo gisanzwe yaba ifite agaciro yonyine. Ibi ntabwo ari byo imibare igaragaza kenshi: ku bihingwa byinshi, guhanura impuzandengo y'akarere ni moderi nziza cyangwa isa n'iziza, ku bihe byose. Uru rupapuro rwerekana moderi enye zose hamwe, ku gihingwa cyose n'igihe cyose, atari inesha gusa.
earlyEstimate.honestyBody2: Aho moderi igoye inesheje, itandukaniro rigereranywa n'itandukaniro riba hagati y'imyaka: iterambere ryoroheje kurusha iryo tandukaniro ntirifatwa nk'inyungu nyayo. Reba urupapuro rw'uburyo bwakoreshejwe kugira ngo umenye uko buri mubare wabazwe.

scenario.title: Igenzura ry'ibishoboka
scenario.tagline: Igereranyo rishingiye kuri moderi ry'umusaruro impuzandengo mu buryo butandukanye bw'ingamba, ku karere kamwe, igihingwa n'igihembwe kimwe icyarimwe.
scenario.pickCaption: Hindura ingamba kugira ngo ubone igereranyo ryabazwe mbere ry'aka karere kuri iyo mvange nyayo.
scenario.pickEmpty: Nta gereranyo ryabazwe mbere kuri aka karere n'iki gihingwa.
scenario.allCombosCaption: Buri mvange y'ingamba 4 zikurikira, zishyizwe ku rutonde hakurikijwe umusaruro impuzandengo uteganyijwe. Ihitamo ryawe ry'ubu rigaragazwa.
scenario.disclaimerTitle: Icyo ari cyo, n'icyo atari cyo
scenario.disclaimerBody: Buri mubare kuri uru rupapuro ni igereranyo ryabazwe mbere rishingiye kuri moderi (moderi ya SHAP na LightGBM), rifatwa ku rutonde rugera ku mvange 16 z'ingamba ku karere no ku gihingwa. Ntabwo ari igerageza ryo mu gihe nyacyo, ntabwo ari indagano ya politiki, kandi ntabwo ari ingaruka zisobanutse: byerekana ibyo moderi ibona bifitanye isano n'imvange runaka y'ingamba mu masambu asa nk'ayo, atari icyazabaho niba umuhinzi runaka azikoresha.

methodology.title: Uburyo bwakoreshejwe
methodology.tagline: Uburyo buri mubare kuri uru rubuga wabazwe, mu magambo yoroshye, hamwe n'imipaka yayo.
methodology.yieldBody: Umusaruro (kg ku hegitari) ubazwa gusa ku masambu afite igihingwa kimwe (nta guhuza ibihingwa) ahingwa n'abahinzi bato, ukoresheje uburemere bwasaruwe bugabanywa n'ubuso, hanyuma bigahurizwa hamwe mu mubare w'akarere hifashishijwe ibipimo by'ubushakashatsi. Icyuho cy'umusaruro ni umusaruro ushobora kugerwaho wagenwe na moderi ukuwemo uyu musaruro nyawo.
methodology.attainableBody1: Umusaruro ushobora kugerwaho ni igipimo cya 90 ku ijana cy'umusaruro wamaze kugerwaho ku masambu asa: icyo icya cumi cy'abahinzi beza kurusha abandi mu karere gasa, igihingwa n'igihembwe bimwe bamaze kugeraho, atari umubare ntarengwa wo mu buhinzi.
methodology.attainableBody2: Amasambu "asa" ashyirwa mu turere 5 dukoresheje uburyo bwa k-means ku bipimo by'ubutaka n'ubuhinzi ku rwego rw'akarere, kubera ko nta karita y'uturere tw'ubuhinzi ihari muri uyu mushinga. Ubu ni uburyo bwakoreshejwe by'agateganyo, atari umupaka w'uturere wemewe.
methodology.driversBody1: Kuri buri gihingwa, moderi ya LightGBM yigishwa guhuza ingamba (imbuto nziza, ifumbire, kuhira, kurwanya isuri, n'ibindi) n'imiterere y'isambu n'umusaruro, hanyuma bikagaragazwa na SHAP kugira ngo hamenyekane ibitera bifitanye isano n'umusaruro mwinshi cyangwa muto. Iyi moderi igenzurwa isiga uturere twose, ntabwo ari uguhitamo bitunguranye, kuko amasambu ari mu karere kamwe adafite ubwigenge.
methodology.driversBody2: Iyi mirongo ni isano gusa. Ko ingamba runaka igaragara hamwe n'umusaruro mwinshi ntibisobanura ko kuyikoresha aribyo bitera uwo musaruro: abahinzi bakoresha ingamba nziza imwe akenshi bakoresha nyinshi, kandi ubutaka bwiza bushobora gukurura ishoramari n'umusaruro mwinshi icyarimwe. Moderi y'igihingwa kimwe (amasaka) ntabwo yanesha igereranyo gisanzwe; urutonde rwayo rukigaragazwa uko ruri, atari guhishwa.
methodology.nowcastBody1: Mbere y'uko ibisubizo by'ubushakashatsi by'igihembwe bisohoka, ubwiza bw'ibimera bufatwa na sateraiti (MODIS NDVI) n'imvura (CHIRPS) bipimwe mu gihe cy'igihembwe, hamwe n'amateka y'umusaruro w'akarere, bikoreshwa mu kugereranya umusaruro w'icyo gihembwe. Buri gereranyo rigenzurwa risiga umwaka umwe, rigereranywa n'uburyo bubiri busanzwe: impuzandengo y'akarere, n'umubare w'igihembwe kimwe umwaka ushize.
methodology.nowcastBody2: Igisubizo cy'ukuri, kigaragazwa cyose ku rupapuro rw'igereranyo rya mbere, ni uko impuzandengo y'akarere ari moderi nziza cyangwa isa n'iziza ku bihingwa n'ibihe byinshi. Ibi bigaragazwa uko biri, atari kubyerekana nk'igiteganyo gikora aho ibimenyetso bidashyigikira ibyo.
methodology.scenarioBody: Igenzura ry'ibishoboka rireba mu rutonde rwabazwe mbere (imvange 16 z'ingamba 4, ku karere no ku gihingwa) rukozwe hifashishijwe isano ya moderi y'ibitera, hamwe n'igipimo cyabazwe hakoreshejwe bootstrap. Ni ugusuzuma mu rutonde, atari igerageza ryo mu gihe nyacyo, kandi ntabwo bivuga ko biteganya ingaruka z'impinduka nyayo ya politiki.
methodology.reliabilityBody1: Buri mubare kuri uru rubuga ufite igipimo cyo kwizerwa, ikimenyetso cy'ukwizerwa, cyangwa byombi. Igice runaka gishyirwaho ikimenyetso hakurikijwe umubare w'amatsinda y'ubushakashatsi n'amasambu abishyigikira:
methodology.reliabilityOk: Byizewe: hari amasambu n'amatsinda ahagije yakorewe ubushakashatsi kugira ngo igereranyo ribe rinoze.
methodology.reliabilityCaution: Koresha witonze: bigera ku mubare ntarengwa w'amatsinda, ariko itandukaniro ry'igereranyo ni rinini.
methodology.reliabilitySuppressed: Ntibigaragajwe: amatsinda make cyane yakorewe ubushakashatsi kugira ngo bigaragazwe neza. Igice kigaragazwa mu bunyu, ntabwo gihishwa, hakurikijwe itegeko ry'uyu mushinga ryo kutigira ibanga.
methodology.validationBody: Nk'igenzura ry'ukwizerwa, igereranyo ry'umusaruro w'ibigori mu gihugu hose ry'uyu mushinga mu gihembwe B 2025 (1,400 kg/ha) ryagereranyijwe n'umubare NISR yasohoye kuri icyo gihe (1,300 kg/ha): itandukaniro rya 7.7%, riri mu gipimo cya 95% cy'uyu mushinga. Imibare y'ubuso n'umusaruro rusange itandukanye kurushaho, kubera ko igereranyo ry'uyu mushinga rireba gusa amasambu afite igihingwa kimwe mu gihe imibare NISR yasohoye irimo n'amasambu ahuza ibihingwa byinshi.

data.title: Inkomoko z'amakuru
data.tagline: Buri bubiko bw'amakuru buri inyuma y'uru rubuga, n'icyo bukoreshwa.
data.surveyCaption: Inkomoko nyamukuru y'imibare yose y'umusaruro, ingamba, n'icyuho.
data.surveyBody: Amakuru y'Ubushakashatsi bw'Ubuhinzi bw'Igihembwe, 2019 kugeza 2025, ibihembwe A na B, Ikigo cy'Igihugu cy'Ibarurishamibare cya Rwanda (NISR). Amakuru y'ubushakashatsi yimbitse ntabwo asohorwa cyangwa agaragazwa hano; ni imibare igereranyijwe ku rwego rw'akarere gusa, ifite umubare ntarengwa muto, igaragara kuri uru rubuga.
data.satelliteCaption: Akoreshwa mu gereranyo rya mbere ry'umusaruro no mu bipimo by'ubutaka n'imvura bya moderi y'ibitera, binyuze muri Google Earth Engine.

satelliteUse.ndvi: ikimenyetso cy'ubwiza bw'ibimera ku gereranyo rya mbere
satelliteUse.rainfall: imibare y'imvura n'itandukaniro ryayo ku gereranyo rya mbere no kuri moderi y'ibitera
satelliteUse.cropland: igarukira NDVI n'imvura ku masambu y'ubuhinzi gusa
satelliteUse.soil: ibipimo by'ubutaka (pH, azote, karubone, n'imiterere) kuri moderi y'ibitera
satelliteUse.terrain: imiterere y'ubutaka ku bijyanye n'uturere n'ibipimo

data.privacyBody: Nta makuru y'umuhinzi ku giti cye, urugo, cyangwa isambu ryigenga rigera kuri uru rubuga cyangwa rikava mu buryo bw'isesengura. Buri mubare ugaragazwa hano ni igereranyo ku rwego rw'akarere x igihingwa x igihembwe x umwaka nibura, ufite umubare ntarengwa muto mbere yo kugaragara.

about.title: Ibirebana na AgriTwin Rwanda
about.tagline: Icyuho cy'umusaruro n'igereranyo rya mbere ry'umusaruro mu Rwanda, byakozwe kuri NISR 2026 Big Data Hackathon.
about.projectBody1: Ubushakashatsi bw'Ubuhinzi bw'Igihembwe bw'u Rwanda bupima ikoreshwa ry'ubutaka, ubuso buhingwa, ibikoreshwa n'umusaruro buri gihembwe, ariko ibisubizo bisohoka gusa nyuma y'igihembwe kurangira. AgriTwin Rwanda ihuza ayo makuru y'ubushakashatsi n'amakuru ya sateraiti n'ikirere kugira ngo yerekane, ku karere no ku gihingwa kimwe kimwe, uburyo umusaruro nyawo uri munsi y'uwo abahinzi basa bamaze kugeraho hafi, ingamba zifitanye isano n'icyo cyuho, n'igereranyo rya mbere, ryagenzuwe mu kuri, ry'uko igihembwe kigenda mbere y'uko imibare y'ubutegetsi isohoka.
about.projectBody2: Byakozwe ku bw'Icyiciro cya 1 (Umusaruro w'Ubuhinzi) cya NISR 2026 Big Data Hackathon, bihuye n'ibyifuzo bya NST2 by'u Rwanda n'intego za Vision 2050 ku byerekeye umusaruro w'ubuhinzi n'ubushobozi bwo guhangana n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere.
about.teamBody: Itsinda ry'abantu babiri: umwe ushinzwe ubwubatsi bw'amakuru, API, n'urubuga, undi ushinzwe uburyo bw'ubushakashatsi, kugenzura, gusuzuma Ikinyarwanda, n'ubushakashatsi bw'inzego z'ubuhinzi.
about.aiBody: Uyu mushinga wakoresheje ubufasha bwa AI mu gukora porogaramu mu gihe cyose wubatswe. Buri gikorwa cyakoresheje AI cyanditswe mu gitabo cy'ikoreshwa rya AI cy'umushinga, hamwe n'ibyakozwe n'ibyagenzuwe n'umuntu. Ibisobanuro mu Kinyarwanda kuri uru rubuga ni umwandiko wa mbere wanditswe na AI, utaragenzurwa n'umuntu uvuga Ikinyarwanda nk'ururimi rwe.
about.contactBody: Inyandiko yose y'uyu mushinga, inyandiko z'uburyo bwakoreshejwe, n'igitabo cy'ibyemezo byafashwe biboneka mu bubiko bwawo, hamwe n'urubuga rw'inyandiko rusobanura neza uburyo bw'amakuru, moderi, na API.
